description: List files in the asset library this key reaches — the personal library for a personal key, the team's shared library for a team key — newest first unless sort says otherwise, one page at a time; pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters and sort to continue (a cursor from another sort is rejected with 400). Narrow it with favorite, collectionId (a folder; folders are created on the web, and an id outside this library is a 404), entityId (the images of one character) and query. Each item's uri (spicy://a/<id>) goes straight into any media field of a model input — no upload or download step. previewUrl is a private preview signed for at most 20 minutes; use it to show the file, never store it. A change the key's team role does not allow gets 403 with reason asset_permission_denied; a key that cannot reach the library gets 403 with asset_workspace_forbidden.

collectionId.description: Only the assets in this folder (a collection of the same library).

entityId.description: Only the images of this character, from spicyapi_characters_list.

favorite.description: true lists only favorites, false only assets that are not favorites.

query.description: Case-insensitive part of the asset name.

sort.description: recent (default, newest first), oldest, name (A to Z) or size (largest first).

source.description: Only assets saved from these sources.

name: spicyapi_assets_list

favorite.description: Favorite mark of the library; in a team library everyone sees the same ones.

model.description: Public name of the model that generated the asset; empty for uploads and links.

modelName.description: Display name of that model; may be empty.

previewUrl.description: Private preview signed for at most 20 minutes; empty when signing failed. Never store or share it; keep uri instead.

uri.description: Stable spicy://a/<id> reference. Put it in any media field of a model input; it works until the asset is deleted and only in requests made with keys of the same workspace.

title: List saved SpicyAPI assets
